psywave.name: Psywave
psywave.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to (user's level) * (X + 50) / 100, where X is a random number from 0 to 100, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.
psywave.shortDesc: Random damage equal to 0.5x-1.5x user's level.

punishment.name: Punishment
punishment.desc: Power is equal to 60+(X*20), where X is the target's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0, but not more than 200 power.
punishment.shortDesc: 60 power +20 for each of the target's stat boosts.

purify.name: Purify
purify.desc: The target is cured if it has a non-volatile status condition. If the target was cured, the user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down.
purify.shortDesc: Cures target's status; heals user 1/2 max HP if so.

pursuit.desc: If an adjacent opposing Pokemon switches out this turn, this move hits that Pokemon before it leaves the field, even if it was not the original target. If the user moves after an opponent using Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch, but not Baton Pass, it will hit that opponent before it leaves the field. Power doubles and no accuracy check is done if the user hits an opponent switching out, and the user's turn is over; if an opponent faints from this, the replacement Pokemon does not become active until the end of the turn.
pursuit.name: Pursuit
pursuit.shortDesc: If a foe is switching out, hits it at 2x power.

quash.name: Quash
quash.desc: Causes the target to take its turn after all other Pokemon this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target already moved this turn.
quash.shortDesc: Forces the target to move last this turn.

rage.name: Rage
rage.desc: Once this move is successfully used, the user's Attack is raised by 1 stage every time it is hit by another Pokemon's attack as long as this move is chosen for use.
rage.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack by 1 if hit during use.

rapidspin.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field.
rapidspin.shortDesc: Frees user from hazards, binding, Leech Seed.
rapidspin.name: Rapid Spin

razorwind.name: Razor Wind
razorwind.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
razorwind.shortDesc: Charges, then hits foe(s) turn 2. High crit ratio.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.desc: The user cures its burn, poison, or paralysis. Fails if the user is not burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.
refresh.shortDesc: User cures its burn, poison, or paralysis.

relicsong.name: Relic Song
relicsong.desc: Has a 10% chance to cause the target to fall asleep. If this move is successful on at least one target and the user is a Meloetta, it changes to Pirouette Forme if it is currently in Aria Forme, or changes to Aria Forme if it is currently in Pirouette Forme. This forme change does not happen if the Meloetta has the Sheer Force Ability. The Pirouette Forme reverts to Aria Forme when Meloetta is not active.
relicsong.shortDesc: 10% chance to sleep foe(s). Meloetta transforms.

return.name: Return
return.desc: Power is equal to the greater of (user's Happiness * 2/5), rounded down, or 1.

revelationdance.name: Revelation Dance
revelationdance.desc: This move's type depends on the user's primary type. If the user's primary type is typeless, this move's type is the user's secondary type if it has one, otherwise the added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat. This move is typeless if the user's type is typeless alone.
revelationdance.shortDesc: Type varies based on the user's primary type.

rockclimb.name: Rock Climb
rockclimb.desc: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

rollingkick.name: Rolling Kick
rollingkick.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
rollingkick.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

rototiller.name: Rototiller
rototiller.desc: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all grounded Grass-type Pokemon on the field by 1 stage.
rototiller.shortDesc: Raises Atk/Sp. Atk of grounded Grass types by 1.

savagespinout.name: Savage Spin-Out
savagespinout.shortDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.
savagespinout.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.

searingsunrazesmash.name: Searing Sunraze Smash
searingsunrazesmash.desc: This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
searingsunrazesmash.shortDesc: Ignores the Abilities of other Pokemon.

secretpower.name: Secret Power
secretpower.desc: Has a 30% chance to cause a secondary effect on the target based on the battle terrain. Causes paralysis on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, causes paralysis during Electric Terrain, lowers Special Attack by 1 stage during Misty Terrain, causes sleep during Grassy Terrain and lowers Speed by 1 stage during Psychic Terrain.
secretpower.shortDesc: Effect varies with terrain. (30% paralysis chance)

seedflare.name: Seed Flare
seedflare.desc: Has a 40% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
seedflare.shortDesc: 40% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 2.

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 1 stage.

shoreup.name: Shore Up
shoreup.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half down. If the weather is Sandstorm, the user instead restores 2/3 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.
shoreup.shortDesc: User restores 1/2 its max HP; 2/3 in Sandstorm.

signalbeam.name: Signal Beam
signalbeam.desc: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.

silverwind.name: Silver Wind
silverwind.desc: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
silverwind.shortDesc: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).

sketch.desc: This move is permanently replaced by the last move used by the target. The copied move has the maximum PP for that move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user has Transformed, or if the move is Chatter, Sketch, Struggle, or any move the user knows.
sketch.name: Sketch
sketch.shortDesc: Permanently copies the last move target used.

skydrop.name: Sky Drop
skydrop.desc: This attack takes the target into the air with the user on the first turn and executes on the second. Pokemon weighing 200 kg or more cannot be lifted. On the first turn, the user and the target avoid all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister. The user and the target cannot make a move between turns, but the target can select a move to use. This move cannot damage Flying-type Pokemon. Fails on the first turn if the target is an ally, if the target has a substitute, or if the target is using Bounce, Dig, Dive, Fly, Phantom Force, Shadow Force, or Sky Drop.
skydrop.shortDesc: User and foe fly up turn 1. Damages on turn 2.

skyuppercut.name: Sky Uppercut
skyuppercut.desc: This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop.
skyuppercut.shortDesc: Can hit Pokemon using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop.

smellingsalts.name: Smelling Salts
smellingsalts.desc: Power doubles if the target is paralyzed. If the user has not fainted, the target is cured of paralysis.
smellingsalts.shortDesc: Power doubles if target is paralyzed, and cures it.

snatch.name: Snatch
snatch.desc: If another Pokemon uses certain non-damaging moves this turn, the user steals that move to use itself. If multiple Pokemon use one of those moves this turn, the applicable moves are all stolen by the first Pokemon in turn order that used this move this turn. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.
snatch.shortDesc: User steals certain support moves to use itself.

sonicboom.name: Sonic Boom
sonicboom.desc: Deals 20 HP of damage to the target.

spiderweb.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped. The effect ends if the user leaves the field.
spiderweb.name: Spider Web
spiderweb.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.

spikecannon.name: Spike Cannon
spikecannon.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

splinteredstormshards.name: Splintered Stormshards
splinteredstormshards.desc: Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.

spotlight.name: Spotlight
spotlight.desc: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from opponents of the target are redirected to the target. Such attacks are redirected to the target before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal.
spotlight.shortDesc: Target's foes' moves are redirected to it this turn.

steamroller.name: Steamroller
steamroller.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.desc: The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. Restores 1/4 of its maximum HP if it's 1, 1/2 of its maximum HP if it's 2, both rounded half down, and all of its HP if it's 3. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. The user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.
swallow.shortDesc: Heals the user based on uses of Stockpile.

switcheroo.name: Switcheroo
switcheroo.desc: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if either the user or the target is holding a Mail or Z-Crystal, if neither is holding an item, if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, a Red Orb, a Griseous Orb, a Plate, a Drive, or a Memory to or from a Kyogre, a Groudon, a Giratina, an Arceus, a Genesect, or a Silvally, respectively. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.
switcheroo.shortDesc: User switches its held item with the target's.

synchronoise.name: Synchronoise
synchronoise.desc: The target is immune if it does not share a type with the user.
synchronoise.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon sharing the user's type.

synthesis.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Delta Stream or no weather conditions are in effect, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Hail, Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, all rounded half down.
synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.shortDesc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

tailglow.name: Tail Glow
tailglow.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack by 3 stages.
tailglow.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 3.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.desc: For 3 turns, the target cannot avoid any attacks made against it, other than OHKO moves, as long as it remains active. During the effect, the target is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will gain the effect. Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball override this move if the target is under any of their effects. Fails if the target is already under this effect or the effects of Ingrain, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows. The target is immune to this move on use if its species is Diglett, Dugtrio, Alolan Diglett, Alolan Dugtrio, Sandygast, Palossand, or Gengar while Mega-Evolved. Mega Gengar cannot be under this effect by any means.
telekinesis.shortDesc: For 3 turns, target floats but moves can't miss it.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.desc: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.
toxic.shortDesc: Badly poisons the target. Poison types can't miss.

toxicthread.name: Toxic Thread
toxicthread.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage and poisons it.
toxicthread.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 and poisons it.

trumpcard.name: Trump Card
trumpcard.desc: The power of this move is based on the amount of PP remaining after normal PP reduction and the Pressure Ability resolve. 200 power for 0 PP, 80 power for 1 PP, 60 power for 2 PP, 50 power for 3 PP, and 40 power for 4 or more PP.
trumpcard.shortDesc: More power the fewer PP this move has left.

twineedle.name: Twineedle
twineedle.desc: Hits twice, with each hit having a 20% chance to poison the target. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
twineedle.shortDesc: Hits 2 times. Each hit has 20% chance to poison.

wakeupslap.shortDesc: Power doubles if target is asleep, and wakes it.

watersport.name: Water Sport
watersport.desc: For 5 turns, all Fire-type attacks used by any active Pokemon have their power multiplied by 0.33. Fails if this effect is already active.
watersport.shortDesc: For 5 turns, Fire-type attacks have 1/3 power.

wringout.name: Wring Out
wringout.desc: Power is equal to 120 * (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.
wringout.shortDesc: More power the more HP the target has left.

anchorshot.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped. The effect ends if the user leaves the field.
anchorshot.name: Anchor Shot
anchorshot.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.

banefulbunker.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user become poisoned. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Protect, Quick Guard, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
banefulbunker.name: Baneful Bunker

batonpass.desc: The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party. The selected Pokemon has the user's stat stage changes transferred to it, as well as the effects of confusion, Aqua Ring, Curse, Embargo, Focus Energy, Gastro Acid, Heal Block, Ingrain, Leech Seed, Lock-On (Mind Reader), Magnet Rise, Perish Song, Power Trick, Telekinesis, the trapped effect of Mean Look (Block, Spider Web), and a substitute with its remaining HP. The effect of Gastro Acid is not transferred if the recipient has an Ability that cannot be affected. The effect of Telekinesis is not transferred if the recipient is Mega Gengar.
batonpass.name: Baton Pass
batonpass.shortDesc: User switches, passing stat changes and more.

bind.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
bind.name: Bind
bind.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

block.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped. The effect ends if the user leaves the field.
block.name: Block
block.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.

copycat.desc: The user uses the last move used by any Pokemon, including itself. Fails if no move has been used, or if the last move used was Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Belch, Bestow, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dragon Tail, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or any Z-Move.
copycat.name: Copycat
copycat.shortDesc: Uses the last move used in the battle.

coreenforcer.desc: If the user moves after the target, the target's Ability is rendered ineffective as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain under this effect. If the target's Ability is Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, or Zen Mode, this effect does not happen, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.
coreenforcer.name: Core Enforcer
coreenforcer.shortDesc: Nullifies the foe(s) Ability if the foe(s) move first.

detect.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Protect, Quick Guard, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
detect.name: Detect
detect.shortDesc: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.

disable.desc: For 4 turns, the target's last move used becomes disabled. Fails if one of the target's moves is already disabled, if the target has not made a move, if the target no longer knows the move, or if the move was a Z-Move. Z-Powered moves can still be selected and executed during this effect.
disable.name: Disable
disable.shortDesc: For 4 turns, disables the target's last move used.

encore.desc: For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Copycat, Encore, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or any Z-Move. Z-Powered moves can still be selected and executed during this effect.
encore.name: Encore
encore.shortDesc: Target repeats its last move for its next 3 turns.

endure.desc: The user will survive attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn with at least 1 HP. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Protect, Quick Guard, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
endure.name: Endure
endure.shortDesc: User survives attacks this turn with at least 1 HP.

entrainment.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Truant, Zen Mode, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Trace, or Zen Mode.
entrainment.name: Entrainment
entrainment.shortDesc: The target's Ability changes to match the user's.

fairylock.desc: Prevents all active Pokemon from switching next turn. A Pokemon can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the effect is already active.
fairylock.name: Fairy Lock
fairylock.shortDesc: Prevents all Pokemon from switching next turn.

firespin.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the target's Ability is Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, or Zen Mode, this move fails, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.
gastroacid.name: Gastro Acid

gravity.desc: For 5 turns, the evasiveness of all active Pokemon is multiplied by 0.6. At the time of use, Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, and Telekinesis end immediately for all active Pokemon. During the effect, Bounce, Fly, Flying Press, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, Splash, and Telekinesis are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. Ground-type attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability can affect Flying types or Pokemon with the Levitate Ability. Fails if this move is already in effect. Relevant Z-Powered moves can still be selected, but will be prevented at execution during this effect.
gravity.name: Gravity

growth.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If the weather is Sunny Day or Desolate Land, this move raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.
growth.name: Growth
growth.shortDesc: Raises user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1; 2 in Sun.

hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.shortDesc: 30% chance to confuse target. Can't miss in rain.

imprison.desc: The user prevents all opposing Pokemon from using any moves that the user also knows as long as the user remains active. Z-Powered moves can still be selected and executed during this effect.
imprison.name: Imprison
imprison.shortDesc: No foe can use any move known by the user.

The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
infestation.name: Infestation
infestation.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

ingrain.desc: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP restored at the end of each turn, but it is prevented from switching out and other Pokemon cannot force the user to switch out. The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the user leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped and still receive the healing effect. During the effect, the user can be hit normally by Ground-type attacks and be affected by Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web, even if the user is a Flying type or has the Levitate Ability.
ingrain.name: Ingrain
ingrain.shortDesc: Traps/grounds user; heals 1/16 max HP per turn.

instruct.desc: The target immediately uses its last used move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, if the target is preparing to use Beak Blast, Focus Punch, or Shell Trap, or if the move is Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Celebrate, Chatter, Copycat, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Ice Ball, Instruct, King's Shield, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Outrage, Petal Dance, Rollout, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Thrash, Transform, Uproar, any two-turn move, any recharge move, or any Z-Move.
instruct.name: Instruct
instruct.shortDesc: The target immediately uses its last used move.

knockoff.desc: If the target is holding an item that can be removed from it, ignoring the Sticky Hold Ability, this move's power is multiplied by 1.5. This move cannot remove Z-Crystals, cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item, cause Pokemon that can Mega Evolve to lose the Mega Stone for their species, or cause a Kyogre, a Groudon, a Giratina, an Arceus, a Genesect, or a Silvally to lose their Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, or Memory respectively. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
knockoff.name: Knock Off
knockoff.shortDesc: 1.5x damage if foe holds an item. Removes item.

meanlook.name: Mean Look
meanlook.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.

metronome.desc: A random move is selected for use, other than After You, Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Belch, Bestow, Celebrate, Chatter, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Crafty Shield, Destiny Bond, Detect, Diamond Storm, Dragon Ascent, Endure, Feint, Fleur Cannon, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Freeze Shock, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, Hyperspace Fury, Hyperspace Hole, Ice Burn, Instruct, King's Shield, Light of Ruin, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mind Blown, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Origin Pulse, Photon Geyser, Plasma Fists, Precipice Blades, Protect, Quash, Quick Guard, Rage Powder, Relic Song, Secret Sword, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snarl, Snatch, Snore, Spectral Thief, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Steam Eruption, Struggle, Switcheroo, Techno Blast, Thief, Thousand Arrows, Thousand Waves, Transform, Trick, V-create, or Wide Guard.
metronome.name: Metronome

mimic.desc: While the user remains active, this move is replaced by the last move used by the target. The copied move has the maximum PP for that move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user has Transformed, if the user already knows the move, or if the move is Chatter, Mimic, Sketch, Struggle, Transform, or any Z-Move.
mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.shortDesc: The last move the target used replaces this one.

protect.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Protect, Quick Guard, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
protect.name: Protect
protect.shortDesc: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.

quickguard.desc: The user and its party members are protected from attacks with original or altered priority greater than 0 made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Protect, Quick Guard, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
quickguard.name: Quick Guard
quickguard.shortDesc: Protects allies from priority attacks this turn.

recycle.desc: The user regains the item it last used. Fails if the user is holding an item, if the user has not held an item, if the item was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by a Pokemon with the Pickup Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be regained.
recycle.name: Recycle
recycle.shortDesc: Restores the item the user last used.

roleplay.desc: The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the user's Ability is Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Zen Mode, or already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode.
roleplay.name: Role Play
roleplay.shortDesc: User replaces its Ability with the target's.

rollout.desc: If this move is successful, the user is locked into this move and cannot make another move until it misses, 5 turns have passed, or the attack cannot be used. Power doubles with each successful hit of this move and doubles again if Defense Curl was used previously by the user. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn. If this move hits an active Disguise during the effect, the power multiplier is paused but the turn counter is not, potentially allowing the multiplier to be used on the user's next move after this effect ends.
rollout.name: Rollout
rollout.shortDesc: Power doubles with each hit. Repeats for 5 turns.

sandtomb.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
sandtomb.name: Sand Tomb
sandtomb.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

simplebeam.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become Simple. Fails if the target's Ability is Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Simple, Stance Change, Truant, or Zen Mode.
simplebeam.name: Simple Beam

skillswap.desc: The user swaps its Ability with the target's Ability. Fails if either the user or the target's Ability is Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Illusion, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode.
skillswap.name: Skill Swap
skillswap.shortDesc: The user and the target trade Abilities.

sleeptalk.desc: One of the user's known moves, besides this move, is selected for use at random. Fails if the user is not asleep. The selected move does not have PP deducted from it, and can currently have 0 PP. This move cannot select Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Celebrate, Chatter, Copycat, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Uproar, any two-turn move, or any Z-Move.
sleeptalk.name: Sleep Talk
sleeptalk.shortDesc: User must be asleep. Uses another known move.

solarbeam.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Hail, Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn.
solarbeam.name: Solar Beam
solarbeam.shortDesc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.

solarblade.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Hail, Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn.
solarblade.name: Solar Blade
solarblade.shortDesc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.

spikyshield.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Protect, Quick Guard, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
spikyshield.name: Spiky Shield
spikyshield.shortDesc: Protects from moves. Contact: loses 1/8 max HP.

spiritshackle.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped. The effect ends if the user leaves the field.
spiritshackle.name: Spirit Shackle
spiritshackle.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.

taunt.desc: Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune. Z-Powered moves can still be selected and executed during this effect.
taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.shortDesc: Target can't use status moves its next 3 turns.

thousandwaves.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped. The effect ends if the user leaves the field.
thousandwaves.name: Thousand Waves
thousandwaves.shortDesc: Hits adjacent foes. Prevents them from switching.

throatchop.desc: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves. Z-Powered sound moves can still be selected and executed during this effect.
throatchop.name: Throat Chop
throatchop.shortDesc: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound moves.

thunder.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, this move's accuracy is 50%.
thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.shortDesc: 30% chance to paralyze. Can't miss in rain.

whirlpool.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

wideguard.desc: The user and its party members are protected from moves made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn that target all adjacent foes or all adjacent Pokemon. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Protect, Quick Guard, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
wideguard.name: Wide Guard
wideguard.shortDesc: Protects allies from multi-target moves this turn.

worryseed.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if the target's Ability is Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Insomnia, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Truant, or Zen Mode.
worryseed.name: Worry Seed

wrap.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Parting Shot, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

allyswitch.desc: The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side.
allyswitch.shortDesc: The user swaps positions with its ally.
allyswitch.name: Ally Switch

aromatherapy.name: Aromatherapy
aromatherapy.desc: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition. Active Pokemon with the Sap Sipper Ability are not cured, unless they are the user.
aromatherapy.shortDesc: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.

auroraveil.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Hail.
auroraveil.shortDesc: For 5 turns, damage to allies is halved. Hail only.
auroraveil.name: Aurora Veil

autotomize.name: Autotomize
autotomize.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages. If the user's Speed was changed, the user's weight is reduced by 100 kg as long as it remains active. This effect is stackable but cannot reduce the user's weight to less than 0.1 kg.
autotomize.shortDesc: Raises the user's Speed by 2; user loses 100 kg.

belch.name: Belch
belch.desc: This move cannot be selected until the user eats a Berry, either by eating one that was held, stealing and eating one off another Pokemon with Bug Bite or Pluck, or eating one that was thrown at it with Fling. Once the condition is met, this move can be selected and used for the rest of the battle even if the user gains or uses another item or switches out. Consuming a Berry with Natural Gift does not count for the purposes of eating one.
belch.shortDesc: Cannot be selected until the user eats a Berry.

blizzard.desc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Hail, this move does not check accuracy.
blizzard.shortDesc: 10% chance to freeze foe(s). Can't miss in Hail.
blizzard.name: Blizzard

bonemerang.name: Bonemerang
bonemerang.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

burnup.desc: Fails unless the user is a Fire type. If this move is successful, the user's Fire type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.
burnup.name: Burn Up
burnup.shortDesc: User's Fire type becomes typeless; must be Fire.

charge.desc: Raises the user's Special Defense by 1 stage. If the user uses an Electric-type attack on the next turn, its power will be doubled.
charge.shortDesc: +1 SpD, user's Electric move next turn 2x power.
charge.name: Charge

craftyshield.name: Crafty Shield
craftyshield.desc: The user and its party members are protected from non-damaging attacks made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
craftyshield.shortDesc: Protects allies from Status moves this turn.

dualchop.name: Dual Chop
dualchop.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

electrify.name: Electrify
electrify.desc: Causes the target's move to become Electric type this turn. Among effects that can change a move's type, this effect happens last. Fails if the target already moved this turn.
electrify.shortDesc: Changes the target's move to Electric this turn.

flowershield.name: Flower Shield
flowershield.desc: Raises the Defense of all active Grass-type Pokemon by 1 stage. Fails if there are no active Grass-type Pokemon.
flowershield.shortDesc: Raises Defense by 1 of all active Grass types.

futuresight.name: Future Sight
futuresight.desc: Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Doom Desire is already in effect for the target's position.
futuresight.shortDesc: Hits two turns after being used.

geargrind.name: Gear Grind
geargrind.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

gearup.name: Gear Up
gearup.desc: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of Pokemon on the user's side with the Plus or Minus Abilities by 1 stage.
gearup.shortDesc: Raises Atk, Sp. Atk of allies with Plus/Minus by 1.

geomancy.name: Geomancy
geomancy.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 2 stages. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
geomancy.shortDesc: Charges, then raises SpA, SpD, Spe by 2 turn 2.

grudge.name: Grudge
grudge.desc: Until the user's next turn, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that move loses all its remaining PP.
grudge.shortDesc: If the user faints, the attack used loses all its PP.

hail.name: Hail
hail.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Hail. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are an Ice type or have the Ice Body, Magic Guard, Overcoat, or Snow Cloak Abilities. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Hail.

headcharge.name: Head Charge
headcharge.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

holdback.name: Hold Back
holdback.desc: Leaves the target with at least 1 HP.
holdback.shortDesc: Always leaves the target with at least 1 HP.

holdhands.name: Hold Hands
holdhands.desc: No competitive use. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

kinesis.name: Kinesis
kinesis.desc: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

landswrath.name: Land's Wrath
landswrath.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

laserfocus.name: Laser Focus
laserfocus.desc: Until the end of the next turn, the user's attacks will be critical hits.
laserfocus.shortDesc: Until the end of the next turn, user's moves crit.

leaftornado.name: Leaf Tornado
leaftornado.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
leaftornado.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.

lovelykiss.name: Lovely Kiss
lovelykiss.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.
lovelykiss.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

lusterpurge.name: Luster Purge
lusterpurge.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
lusterpurge.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

magiccoat.name: Magic Coat
magiccoat.desc: Until the end of the turn, the user is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this move takes effect.

matblock.name: Mat Block
matblock.desc: The user and its party members are protected from damaging attacks made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field, if the user moves last this turn, or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
matblock.shortDesc: Protects allies from damaging attacks. Turn 1 only.

milkdrink.name: Milk Drink
milkdrink.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
milkdrink.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

mindblown.name: Mind Blown
mindblown.desc: Whether or not this move is successful and even if it would cause fainting, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, unless the user has the Magic Guard Ability. This move is prevented from executing and the user does not lose HP if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability, or if this move is Fire type and the user is affected by Powder or the weather is Primordial Sea.
mindblown.shortDesc: User loses 50% max HP. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

mindreader.name: Mind Reader
mindreader.desc: Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field. Fails if this effect is active for the user.
mindreader.shortDesc: User's next move will not miss the target.

mirrorcoat.name: Mirror Coat
mirrorcoat.desc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a special attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's special attack this turn.
mirrorcoat.shortDesc: If hit by special attack, returns double damage.

mistball.name: Mist Ball
mistball.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
mistball.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

naturepower.name: Nature Power
naturepower.desc: This move calls another move for use based on the battle terrain. Tri Attack on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, Thunderbolt during Electric Terrain, Moonblast during Misty Terrain, Energy Ball during Grassy Terrain, and Psychic during Psychic Terrain.
naturepower.shortDesc: Attack depends on terrain (default Tri Attack).

oblivionwing.name: Oblivion Wing
oblivionwing.desc: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
oblivionwing.shortDesc: User recovers 75% of the damage dealt.

octazooka.name: Octazooka
octazooka.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
octazooka.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.

plasmafists.name: Plasma Fists
plasmafists.desc: If this move is successful, causes Normal-type moves to become Electric type this turn.
plasmafists.shortDesc: Normal moves become Electric type this turn.

poweruppunch.name: Power-Up Punch
poweruppunch.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.
poweruppunch.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.

psychoshift.name: Psycho Shift
psychoshift.desc: The user's non-volatile status condition is transferred to the target, and the user is then cured. Fails if the user has no non-volatile status condition or if the target already has one.
psychoshift.shortDesc: Transfers the user's status ailment to the target.

recover.name: Recover
recover.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
recover.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

rest.name: Rest
rest.desc: The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.
rest.shortDesc: User sleeps 2 turns and restores HP and status.

revenge.name: Revenge
revenge.desc: Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.
revenge.shortDesc: Power doubles if user is damaged by the target.

roost.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. Until the end of the turn, Flying-type users lose their Flying type and pure Flying-type users become Normal type. Does nothing if the user's HP is full.
roost.name: Roost
roost.shortDesc: Heals 50% HP. Flying-type removed 'til turn ends.

searingshot.name: Searing Shot
searingshot.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.

secretsword.name: Secret Sword
secretsword.desc: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.
secretsword.shortDesc: Damages target based on Defense, not Sp. Def.

shadowbone.name: Shadow Bone
shadowbone.desc: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
shadowbone.shortDesc: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

shelltrap.name: Shell Trap
shelltrap.desc: Fails unless the user is hit by a physical attack from an opponent this turn before it can execute the move. If the user was hit and has not fainted, it attacks immediately after being hit, and the effect ends. If the opponent's physical attack had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability, it does not count for the purposes of this effect.
shelltrap.shortDesc: User must take physical damage before moving.

skullbash.name: Skull Bash
skullbash.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
skullbash.shortDesc: Raises user's Defense by 1 on turn 1. Hits turn 2.

slackoff.name: Slack Off
slackoff.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
slackoff.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

softboiled.name: Soft-Boiled
softboiled.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
softboiled.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

spectralthief.name: Spectral Thief
spectralthief.desc: The target's stat stages greater than 0 are stolen from it and applied to the user before dealing damage.
spectralthief.shortDesc: Steals target's boosts before dealing damage.

stickyweb.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, lowering the Speed by 1 stage of each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
stickyweb.name: Sticky Web
stickyweb.shortDesc: Lowers Speed of grounded foes by 1 on switch-in.

stormthrow.name: Storm Throw
stormthrow.desc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
stormthrow.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit.

submission.name: Submission
submission.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

technoblast.name: Techno Blast
technoblast.desc: This move's type depends on the user's held Drive.
technoblast.shortDesc: Type varies based on the held Drive.

thousandarrows.name: Thousand Arrows
thousandarrows.desc: This move can hit airborne Pokemon, which includes Flying-type Pokemon, Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, Pokemon holding an Air Balloon, and Pokemon under the effect of Magnet Rise or Telekinesis. If the target is a Flying type and is not already grounded, this move deals neutral damage regardless of its other type(s). This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.
thousandarrows.shortDesc: Grounds adjacent foes. First hit neutral on Flying.

trickortreat.name: Trick-or-Treat
trickortreat.desc: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.
trickortreat.shortDesc: Adds Ghost to the target's type(s).

vcreate.name: V-create
vcreate.desc: Lowers the user's Speed, Defense, and Special Defense by 1 stage.
vcreate.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Defense, Sp. Def, Speed by 1.

venomdrench.name: Venom Drench
venomdrench.desc: Lowers the target's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 1 stage if the target is poisoned. Fails if the target is not poisoned.
venomdrench.shortDesc: Lowers Atk/Sp. Atk/Speed of poisoned foes by 1.

vitalthrow.name: Vital Throw
vitalthrow.desc: This move does not check accuracy.
vitalthrow.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy. Goes last.

triplekick.name: Triple Kick
triplekick.desc: Hits three times. Power increases to 20 for the second hit and 30 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.
triplekick.shortDesc: Hits 3 times. Each hit can miss, but power rises.

tropkick.name: Trop Kick
tropkick.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
tropkick.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

twister.name: Twister
twister.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Power doubles if the target is using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop.
twister.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.desc: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.
uproar.shortDesc: Lasts 3 turns. Active Pokemon cannot fall asleep.

uturn.name: U-turn
uturn.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
uturn.shortDesc: User switches out after damaging the target.

venoshock.name: Venoshock
venoshock.desc: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.
venoshock.shortDesc: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.

voltswitch.name: Volt Switch
voltswitch.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
voltswitch.shortDesc: User switches out after damaging the target.

volttackle.name: Volt Tackle
volttackle.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
volttackle.shortDesc: Has 33% recoil. 10% chance to paralyze target.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
waterfall.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

waterpledge.name: Water Pledge
waterpledge.desc: If one of the user's allies chose to use Fire Pledge or Grass Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Fire Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Grass Pledge with 150 power and a swamp appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which quarters the Speed of each Pokemon on that side. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Water Gem, and cannot be redirected by the Storm Drain Ability.
waterpledge.shortDesc: Use with Grass or Fire Pledge for added effect.

waterpulse.name: Water Pulse
waterpulse.desc: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

waterspout.name: Water Spout
waterspout.desc: Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.
waterspout.shortDesc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
whirlwind.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

wildcharge.name: Wild Charge
wildcharge.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

wish.name: Wish
wish.desc: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.
wish.shortDesc: Next turn, 50% of the user's max HP is restored.

withdraw.name: Withdraw
withdraw.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.

wonderroom.name: Wonder Room
wonderroom.desc: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defense and Special Defense stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
wonderroom.shortDesc: For 5 turns, all Defense and Sp. Def stats switch.

woodhammer.name: Wood Hammer
woodhammer.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

workup.name: Work Up
workup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
workup.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.
yawn.shortDesc: Puts the target to sleep after 1 turn.

zapcannon.name: Zap Cannon
zapcannon.desc: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

zenheadbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zenheadbutt.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
zenheadbutt.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

zingzap.name: Zing Zap
zingzap.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
zingzap.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
